integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] Photorealistic live-action culinary action-comedy inside a warmly lit Japanese-style noodle restaurant. Begin exactly aligned with <Picture 1>. A young East Asian chef with messy black hair, wearing a white chef jacket and dark waist apron, stands behind the wooden counter on the left, holding a large bundle of long pale hand-pulled noodles above his head. A stern bald middle-aged East Asian male food critic wearing round glasses, a black jacket and black turtleneck sits on the right, watching the chef suspiciously. Preserve their exact facial identities, clothing, noodle bundle, counter, restaurant, lighting and spatial positions.

00:00–00:03 — The chef confidently demonstrates a spectacular hand-pulled noodle flourish. He stretches the long noodles between his hands and swings them in a smooth controlled arc above the counter. The critic raises one eyebrow, unimpressed. The noodles move as one continuous flexible bundle with physically realistic stretching and momentum.

00:03–00:06 — The chef attempts a final dramatic overhead flourish. His leading foot slips slightly on flour scattered across the floor. He regains his balance, but accidentally releases the noodle bundle from both hands. His eyes widen in horror as the noodles fly toward the seated critic. The release happens once, clearly visible, without any object duplication.

00:06–00:10 — The noodles travel along a continuous curved trajectory from left to right. Individual strands trail and bend naturally due to momentum and gravity. The critic slowly looks upward, changing from stern disbelief to startled alarm. Keep the chef, noodles and critic visible together, making the entire trajectory easy to follow.

00:10–00:12 — The bundle of soft, room-temperature demonstration noodles falls onto the critic's bald head, draping over his scalp and round glasses like an absurd long white wig. The noodles settle naturally along the sides of his face without changing material or quantity. The chef freezes with both hands raised.

00:12–00:15 — The critic stares forward with a perfectly deadpan, deeply offended expression while wearing the dangling noodle wig. The chef recoils slightly, hands open in shock and embarrassment. Hold this awkward tableau and progressively align the final facial expressions, noodle placement, character positions and medium-wide composition with <Picture 2> at exactly 15.00 seconds.

One continuous uninterrupted shot, essentially fixed camera with a very subtle forward push. Natural real-time movement, stable character identity, accurate human anatomy, physically correct noodle flexibility, gravity and contact. No sudden morphing, no disappearing noodles, no extra fingers, no duplicated props, no slow motion and no subtitles.

overall_soundscape:
Warm restaurant ambience, distant boiling water, the soft whipping sound of stretched noodles, a sudden shoe slide on the floor, the chef's sharp surprised breath, noodles landing softly on the critic's head, then an awkward silence followed by a quiet cough. All physical sounds match visible events.

non_diegetic_music:
Original energetic cooking-show percussion during the initial flourish. Music cuts off abruptly when the noodles are released. One short dry comedic plucked-string accent at the final deadpan reaction.
